name: sawant-group-erp
description: Sawant Group Enterprise ERP (Unit 1: Talwade, Unit 2: Sawardari, Unit 3: Varale)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix packages/registry install && npm --prefix packages/calc install && npm --prefix packages/statutory install && npm --prefix apps/api install && npm --prefix apps/web install && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix apps/api run dev" "npm --prefix apps/web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.build:web: npm --prefix packages/registry install && npm --prefix apps/web install && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix packages/registry run lint && npm --prefix apps/api run lint && npm --prefix apps/web run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix packages/registry run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/calc run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/statutory run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/api run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix packages/registry run test && npm --prefix packages/calc run test && npm --prefix packages/statutory run test && npm --prefix apps/api run test && npm --prefix apps/web run test
scripts.verify: npm run secrets:scan && npm run check:unbounded && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
